deb-1786602018.sample_context: Sample ID: BR-GOA-001. Location: Goa Mandovi Estuary. eDNA Detections: Tor putitora (Endangered), Clarias gariepinus (Invasive), Labeo rohita (Native).

messages.message: Based on BioRadar eDNA findings for BR-GOA-001, we must enforce immediate buffer zone protections to preserve native species habitat.
We understand conservation needs, but complete fishing bans will destroy our community's livelihood. We need seasonal zoning instead.
BioRadar eDNA confirms IUCN Endangered species presence in BR-GOA-001. We demand zero-tolerance habitat destruction policy.
Under Section 36 of the Biological Diversity Act 2002, local authorities are mandated to notify Biodiversity Heritage Sites when rare taxa are flagged.
The data clearly indicates ecosystem degradation risk if invasive species spread unchecked downstream.
If regulated gear is permitted during non-breeding periods, economic activity can co-exist with native protection.

consensus.consensus_recommendation: Establish a 6-month seasonal Biodiversity Conservation Reserve at BR-GOA-001 with community fishing quotas, mandatory invasive species eradication protocols, and legal designation under the Biological Diversity Act.
dissenting_opinions: Local Fisherman Co-op requested complete exemption from seasonal gear bans during peak harvest months.
Conservation NGO advocated for permanent, non-expiring sanctuary boundaries without commercial access.
consensus.statutory_compliance_framework: Biological Diversity Act 2002 (Sec 36) & Wildlife Protection Act 1972 (Schedule I protection)
